# Panda Design System

> Themeable, accessible React components (@ds/react) and CSS design tokens (@ds/tokens). Three brands (Diamond, Amber, Opal), light and dark, English and Arabic (RTL), two densities, three radius styles, four shadow levels. WCAG 2.2 AA in every theme.

Use library components instead of raw HTML, only documented props, and tokens instead of raw values. Start with foundations.json for the always-on rules, then fetch a component’s contract before using it.

## Components
- [Accordion](https://osama-eldrieny.github.io/design-system-ful-example/ai/components/accordion.md): An accordion stacks sections whose content shows and hides when their heading is pressed, such as an FAQ. Contract: https://osama-eldrieny.github.io/design-system-ful-example/ai/components/accordion.json
- [Alert](https://osama-eldrieny.github.io/design-system-ful-example/ai/components/alert.md): An alert shows a message about the page or the result of an action: information, success, a warning or an error. Contract: https://osama-eldrieny.github.io/design-system-ful-example/ai/components/alert.json
- [AppsNotifications](https://osama-eldrieny.github.io/design-system-ful-example/ai/components/apps-notifications.md): A settings panel with one switch per app, to turn each app’s notifications on or off. Contract: https://osama-eldrieny.github.io/design-system-ful-example/ai/components/apps-notifications.json
- [Avatar](https://osama-eldrieny.github.io/design-system-ful-example/ai/components/avatar.md): An avatar represents a person or team with their photo, or their initials when there’s no photo. Contract: https://osama-eldrieny.github.io/design-system-ful-example/ai/components/avatar.json
- [Badge](https://osama-eldrieny.github.io/design-system-ful-example/ai/components/badge.md): A badge is a small, non-interactive label for a status (“Paid”, “New”) or a count (3 unread). Contract: https://osama-eldrieny.github.io/design-system-ful-example/ai/components/badge.json
- [Breadcrumb](https://osama-eldrieny.github.io/design-system-ful-example/ai/components/breadcrumb.md): A breadcrumb shows where the current page sits in the site’s hierarchy, with links back up each level. Contract: https://osama-eldrieny.github.io/design-system-ful-example/ai/components/breadcrumb.json
- [Button](https://osama-eldrieny.github.io/design-system-ful-example/ai/components/button.md): A button triggers an action in place: saving a form, opening a dialog, deleting an item. Contract: https://osama-eldrieny.github.io/design-system-ful-example/ai/components/button.json
- [ButtonGroup](https://osama-eldrieny.github.io/design-system-ful-example/ai/components/button-group.md): A button group shows related buttons together, spaced or attached into one control. Contract: https://osama-eldrieny.github.io/design-system-ful-example/ai/components/button-group.json
- [Card](https://osama-eldrieny.github.io/design-system-ful-example/ai/components/card.md): A card groups content and actions about one subject, such as an article, a product or a person, into a single container. Contract: https://osama-eldrieny.github.io/design-system-ful-example/ai/components/card.json
- [Checkbox](https://osama-eldrieny.github.io/design-system-ful-example/ai/components/checkbox.md): A checkbox turns one option on or off, or lets people pick any number of options from a list. Contract: https://osama-eldrieny.github.io/design-system-ful-example/ai/components/checkbox.json
- [ChooseCard](https://osama-eldrieny.github.io/design-system-ful-example/ai/components/choose-card.md): Choose cards are large radio buttons: each option is a card with a name, a description and an optional price, and people pick exactly one. Contract: https://osama-eldrieny.github.io/design-system-ful-example/ai/components/choose-card.json
- [Code](https://osama-eldrieny.github.io/design-system-ful-example/ai/components/code.md): Code shows code inline in text or as a block with a language label and a copy button. Contract: https://osama-eldrieny.github.io/design-system-ful-example/ai/components/code.json
- [Combobox](https://osama-eldrieny.github.io/design-system-ful-example/ai/components/combobox.md): A combobox is a text field with a list of suggestions: people type to filter and pick one option, or several shown as removable chips. Contract: https://osama-eldrieny.github.io/design-system-ful-example/ai/components/combobox.json
- [Container](https://osama-eldrieny.github.io/design-system-ful-example/ai/components/container.md): Container centers page content with a maximum width and page gutters that follow density, with smaller gutters on phones.. Contract: https://osama-eldrieny.github.io/design-system-ful-example/ai/components/container.json
- [Divider](https://osama-eldrieny.github.io/design-system-ful-example/ai/components/divider.md): A divider is a thin line that separates groups of content, horizontally or vertically, optionally with a short label such as “or”.. Contract: https://osama-eldrieny.github.io/design-system-ful-example/ai/components/divider.json
- [Drawer](https://osama-eldrieny.github.io/design-system-ful-example/ai/components/drawer.md): A drawer is a panel that slides in from an edge of the screen for secondary tasks such as filters, settings or item details. Contract: https://osama-eldrieny.github.io/design-system-ful-example/ai/components/drawer.json
- [DropdownMenu](https://osama-eldrieny.github.io/design-system-ful-example/ai/components/dropdown-menu.md): A dropdown menu shows a list of actions or options when people press a button. Contract: https://osama-eldrieny.github.io/design-system-ful-example/ai/components/dropdown-menu.json
- [EmptyState](https://osama-eldrieny.github.io/design-system-ful-example/ai/components/empty-state.md): An empty state fills a space that has nothing to show yet, like an empty list or no search results, and explains why and what to do next.. Contract: https://osama-eldrieny.github.io/design-system-ful-example/ai/components/empty-state.json
- [Footer](https://osama-eldrieny.github.io/design-system-ful-example/ai/components/footer.md): The page footer: a copyright line and secondary links such as Privacy, Terms and Help. Contract: https://osama-eldrieny.github.io/design-system-ful-example/ai/components/footer.json
- [FormField](https://osama-eldrieny.github.io/design-system-ful-example/ai/components/form-field.md): FormField puts a label, help text and an error or success message around a form control and wires them together, so screen readers announce the label, hint and error with the control. Contract: https://osama-eldrieny.github.io/design-system-ful-example/ai/components/form-field.json
- [Grid](https://osama-eldrieny.github.io/design-system-ful-example/ai/components/grid.md): Grid lays children out in equal columns: a fixed number, or as many as fit (auto), so it reflows on small screens.. Contract: https://osama-eldrieny.github.io/design-system-ful-example/ai/components/grid.json
- [Header](https://osama-eldrieny.github.io/design-system-ful-example/ai/components/header.md): A page header that introduces a person and their page: avatar, name, job title and the page heading. Contract: https://osama-eldrieny.github.io/design-system-ful-example/ai/components/header.json
- [HoverCard](https://osama-eldrieny.github.io/design-system-ful-example/ai/components/hover-card.md): A hover card previews what a link points to, such as a person’s profile, when a mouse user points at it or a keyboard user focuses it. Contract: https://osama-eldrieny.github.io/design-system-ful-example/ai/components/hover-card.json
- [Inline](https://osama-eldrieny.github.io/design-system-ful-example/ai/components/inline.md): Inline lays its children out in a row that wraps onto more lines, e.g. Contract: https://osama-eldrieny.github.io/design-system-ful-example/ai/components/inline.json
- [InputField](https://osama-eldrieny.github.io/design-system-ful-example/ai/components/input-field.md): An input field lets people enter a single line of text: a name, an email address, a search term. Contract: https://osama-eldrieny.github.io/design-system-ful-example/ai/components/input-field.json
- [Kbd](https://osama-eldrieny.github.io/design-system-ful-example/ai/components/kbd.md): Kbd shows a keyboard key or a shortcut, such as Ctrl + K, in text, menus and tooltips.. Contract: https://osama-eldrieny.github.io/design-system-ful-example/ai/components/kbd.json
- [Link](https://osama-eldrieny.github.io/design-system-ful-example/ai/components/link.md): A link takes people to another page or place. Contract: https://osama-eldrieny.github.io/design-system-ful-example/ai/components/link.json
- [List](https://osama-eldrieny.github.io/design-system-ful-example/ai/components/list.md): A list shows related items one per row, with an optional icon or avatar, a second line and trailing meta such as a date. Contract: https://osama-eldrieny.github.io/design-system-ful-example/ai/components/list.json
- [Logo](https://osama-eldrieny.github.io/design-system-ful-example/ai/components/logo.md): The logo shows the product’s mark and name, usually at the start of the navigation bar, linking to the home page. Contract: https://osama-eldrieny.github.io/design-system-ful-example/ai/components/logo.json
- [MeetingCard](https://osama-eldrieny.github.io/design-system-ful-example/ai/components/meeting-card.md): A meeting card shows one event in an agenda or schedule: its name, time and attendees, with a color edge for its status. Contract: https://osama-eldrieny.github.io/design-system-ful-example/ai/components/meeting-card.json
- [Modal](https://osama-eldrieny.github.io/design-system-ful-example/ai/components/modal.md): A modal is a dialog over the page that people must deal with before going back: a short form, a confirmation or details. Contract: https://osama-eldrieny.github.io/design-system-ful-example/ai/components/modal.json
- [Navbar](https://osama-eldrieny.github.io/design-system-ful-example/ai/components/navbar.md): The navigation bar at the top of a site or app: the logo, links to the main sections, and optional actions such as search. Contract: https://osama-eldrieny.github.io/design-system-ful-example/ai/components/navbar.json
- [Pagination](https://osama-eldrieny.github.io/design-system-ful-example/ai/components/pagination.md): Pagination moves between pages of a long list or table. Contract: https://osama-eldrieny.github.io/design-system-ful-example/ai/components/pagination.json
- [Popover](https://osama-eldrieny.github.io/design-system-ful-example/ai/components/popover.md): A popover shows interactive content anchored to a button, such as a small form, filters or details. Contract: https://osama-eldrieny.github.io/design-system-ful-example/ai/components/popover.json
- [ProductCard](https://osama-eldrieny.github.io/design-system-ful-example/ai/components/product-card.md): A product card shows one product in a grid or list: photo, name, short description, rating and price, with an optional sale price and actions. Contract: https://osama-eldrieny.github.io/design-system-ful-example/ai/components/product-card.json
- [Progress](https://osama-eldrieny.github.io/design-system-ful-example/ai/components/progress.md): A progress bar shows how far a task has got, such as an upload or setup steps. Contract: https://osama-eldrieny.github.io/design-system-ful-example/ai/components/progress.json
- [RadioGroup](https://osama-eldrieny.github.io/design-system-ful-example/ai/components/radio-group.md): A radio group lets people pick exactly one option from a short list, with every option visible at once. Contract: https://osama-eldrieny.github.io/design-system-ful-example/ai/components/radio-group.json
- [SearchField](https://osama-eldrieny.github.io/design-system-ful-example/ai/components/search-field.md): A search field has a search icon, a clear button and an optional keyboard shortcut that focuses it from anywhere on the page. Contract: https://osama-eldrieny.github.io/design-system-ful-example/ai/components/search-field.json
- [Select](https://osama-eldrieny.github.io/design-system-ful-example/ai/components/select.md): A select lets people pick one option from a list that opens below the field. Contract: https://osama-eldrieny.github.io/design-system-ful-example/ai/components/select.json
- [SideNav](https://osama-eldrieny.github.io/design-system-ful-example/ai/components/side-nav.md): A side navigation lists the pages of an app or docs site in sections, with icons and nested groups that expand and collapse. Contract: https://osama-eldrieny.github.io/design-system-ful-example/ai/components/side-nav.json
- [Skeleton](https://osama-eldrieny.github.io/design-system-ful-example/ai/components/skeleton.md): A skeleton is a grey placeholder in the shape of content that is loading: lines of text, image blocks and avatar circles. Contract: https://osama-eldrieny.github.io/design-system-ful-example/ai/components/skeleton.json
- [Slider](https://osama-eldrieny.github.io/design-system-ful-example/ai/components/slider.md): A slider sets a number, or a range with two thumbs, by dragging along a track or with the arrow keys. Contract: https://osama-eldrieny.github.io/design-system-ful-example/ai/components/slider.json
- [Spinner](https://osama-eldrieny.github.io/design-system-ful-example/ai/components/spinner.md): A spinner shows that something is loading when the time it takes is unknown. Contract: https://osama-eldrieny.github.io/design-system-ful-example/ai/components/spinner.json
- [Stack](https://osama-eldrieny.github.io/design-system-ful-example/ai/components/stack.md): Stack lays its children out vertically with even spacing from the density-aware spacing scale.. Contract: https://osama-eldrieny.github.io/design-system-ful-example/ai/components/stack.json
- [Stat](https://osama-eldrieny.github.io/design-system-ful-example/ai/components/stat.md): A stat shows one key figure with its label and change, such as revenue up 12.5% vs last month. Contract: https://osama-eldrieny.github.io/design-system-ful-example/ai/components/stat.json
- [Stepper](https://osama-eldrieny.github.io/design-system-ful-example/ai/components/stepper.md): A stepper shows progress through a task with several steps, such as checkout: which steps are done, which is current and what’s left. Contract: https://osama-eldrieny.github.io/design-system-ful-example/ai/components/stepper.json
- [Switch](https://osama-eldrieny.github.io/design-system-ful-example/ai/components/switch.md): A switch turns a single setting on or off and applies the change immediately, like a light switch. Contract: https://osama-eldrieny.github.io/design-system-ful-example/ai/components/switch.json
- [Table](https://osama-eldrieny.github.io/design-system-ful-example/ai/components/table.md): A table shows rows and columns of data people compare: sortable columns, selectable rows with select-all, a sticky header, striped or compact rows, and loading and empty states. Contract: https://osama-eldrieny.github.io/design-system-ful-example/ai/components/table.json
- [Tabs](https://osama-eldrieny.github.io/design-system-ful-example/ai/components/tabs.md): Tabs switch between related views of content in the same place, one at a time. Contract: https://osama-eldrieny.github.io/design-system-ful-example/ai/components/tabs.json
- [Tag](https://osama-eldrieny.github.io/design-system-ful-example/ai/components/tag.md): A tag labels an item with a keyword or category. Contract: https://osama-eldrieny.github.io/design-system-ful-example/ai/components/tag.json
- [Textarea](https://osama-eldrieny.github.io/design-system-ful-example/ai/components/textarea.md): A multi-line text field for longer answers such as messages, comments or descriptions. Contract: https://osama-eldrieny.github.io/design-system-ful-example/ai/components/textarea.json
- [Toast](https://osama-eldrieny.github.io/design-system-ful-example/ai/components/toast.md): A toast is a brief message about something that just happened, such as “Changes saved”, shown in a corner and dismissed automatically. Contract: https://osama-eldrieny.github.io/design-system-ful-example/ai/components/toast.json
- [Tooltip](https://osama-eldrieny.github.io/design-system-ful-example/ai/components/tooltip.md): A tooltip shows a short text hint for a control when it’s hovered or focused, such as the name of an icon button. Contract: https://osama-eldrieny.github.io/design-system-ful-example/ai/components/tooltip.json

## Tools
- MCP server: `npx ds-mcp` (list_components, get_component, get_tokens, validate_code, …)
- Validator: `npx ds-validate <files> --json`
- [Everything in one file](https://osama-eldrieny.github.io/design-system-ful-example/llms-full.txt)
